summary: Improve QGIS data checks, spatial analysis and repeatable workflows in five days. Explore the syllabus and see whether it fits your GIS role.
lede: Advanced GIS analysis helps GIS analysts, spatial planners and mapping specialists build repeatable workflows for complex spatial data and location-based questions. You’ll practise validating coordinate systems and geometry, applying vector and raster analysis, and building reusable QGIS processing models, then document methods, uncertainty and map results.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already use GIS and need more control over spatial data quality, analysis workflows and map outputs.
outcomes: QGIS Map Layout and Decision Reports
modules: QGIS Map Layout and Decision Reports
prerequisites: Prior experience using GIS software is expected, including familiarity with spatial layers, attribute tables and basic map creation. No programming is required. Bring a laptop capable of running QGIS; exercises focus on operational use of GIS tools rather than software engineering.
